c74object.name: py_code
c74object.description: An in-patch Python editor with tree-sitter syntax highlighting, auto-indent, bracket matching, undo, completion and snippets. Each evaluation leaves its outlet as one exec or eval message; connect it to py. The text is saved with the patch.

inlet.description: Receives theme, themes, snippets, scrollspeed and attribute messages.

outlet.digest: exec or eval code, to py
outlet.description: The code goes as one symbol, so line breaks, commas, semicolons and quotes reach py intact. A single expression is sent as eval, so py outputs its value; statements are sent as exec, and py bangs on success.

method.name: (keyboard)
method.description:
Click the box to give it the focus, then:
Shift+Return: evaluate the current line.
Cmd+Return: evaluate the selection, else the top-level statement under the caret (a whole function or class, with its decorators), else the line.
Cmd+Shift+Return: evaluate the whole text.
Indented code is dedented before it is sent, so a line inside a function can be run alone.
Return: new line, indented one level after a colon, one level less after return, pass, break, continue or raise, and inside open brackets either one level in or aligned with the first argument.
Typing else:, elif, except or finally, or a closing bracket at the start of a line, moves the line back to its block.
Tab: insert the completion candidate, else indent. Shift+Tab: next candidate, else outdent. Esc: close the candidate.
Cmd+Z, Cmd+Shift+Z: undo, redo. Cmd+X, Cmd+C, Cmd+V, Cmd+A: cut, copy, paste, select all.

method.name: (mouse)
method.description: Click and drag to select; double-click selects a word, triple-click a line. The wheel or trackpad scrolls (see scrollspeed). Right-click opens a menu: Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select All, Save to .py and Load from .py. Saving or loading sets file to the chosen path.

method.name: (drag)
method.digest: Drop files to insert their paths
method.description: Dropping files from the Finder inserts each absolute path as a double-quoted Python string at the caret.

method.name: themes
method.description: Posts the preset names and the one in use to the Max console.

method.name: snippets
method.description: Loads a text file of entries, each starting with a line ### key and followed by its body verbatim. Evaluating exactly snip.key replaces it with the body (one undo step) and sends nothing. The file is reloaded when it changes. With no path, snippets are cleared.

attribute.name: theme
attribute.description: Copies a preset over the 21 color attributes: onedark (default), catppuccin, dracula, nord, gruvbox, monokai, solarized. Names ignore case, spaces, - and _. A color attribute set in the box overrides the preset.

attribute.name: fontsize
attribute.description: Menlo, in points, clamped to 6-48. Default 12.

attribute.name: tabwidth
attribute.description: Spaces per indent level, for Tab, Shift+Tab and auto-indent, clamped to 1-16. Default 4.

attribute.name: readonly
attribute.description: Disables editing. Navigation, copy and evaluation still work. Default 0.

attribute.name: autoclose
attribute.description: Inserts the closing ) ] } or quote. A quote after a word does not pair (don't) unless the word is a string prefix (f", rb'); a third quote closes as a triple. Typing a closer over the same character moves past it. Default 1.

attribute.name: wrap
attribute.description: Wraps lines at the box width. 0 keeps one row per line. Default 1.

attribute.name: matchbrackets
attribute.description: Highlights the bracket paired with the one next to the caret. Brackets inside strings and comments never match. Default 1.

attribute.name: titlebar
attribute.description: A strip at the top labelled python. Default 1.

attribute.name: completion
attribute.description: Reserves a line at the bottom. After three letters it shows the best candidate from the document's names and Python keywords and builtins; Tab inserts it, Shift+Tab cycles. Default 1.

attribute.name: autoload
attribute.description: Reads file into the editor when the attribute is set. Default 1.

attribute.name: autowrite
attribute.description: Writes the text to file 400 ms after the last edit, and when the object is deleted. Default 0.

attribute.name: blink
attribute.description: Flashes the evaluated span in blinkcolor. Default 1.

attribute.name: file
attribute.description: Path of a .py file. Read when set if autoload is on; written by autowrite and by Save in the context menu. Text saved with the patch wins over the file.

attribute.name: snippets
attribute.description: Path of a snippets file (~ is expanded, one pair of quotes is dropped). See the snippets message.

attribute.name: scrollspeed
attribute.description: Multiplies the scroll delta, clamped to 0.05-50. Default 3.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.digest: Text color (names and other untagged text)

attribute.name: builtincolor
attribute.digest: Builtin color (print, len, None, True, False)

attribute.name: escapecolor
attribute.digest: Escape sequence and f-string brace color

c74object.discussion: py_code never runs Python: it only sends messages from its outlet. Expanding a snip.key sends nothing. The text, caret and scroll position are saved with the patch. py_code is derived from sc_code in gus74vv/sc3-tilde and is licensed GPL-3.0-only.
